messages:
samir_ops: Hey — we need to lock a PIR for the prod latency incident (INC-2026-042). Looking for a facilitator and attendee check. Earliest windows: Thu Mar 12 09:00-10:00 PT or Fri Mar 13 16:00-17:00 PT. Preferences?

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 summary: increased p99 latency across writer pool. Start 2026-03-08T16:02Z, mitigated 2026-03-08T16:14Z. Customers impacted: ~12 orgs, degraded index writes. Links: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-042

lina_prod: I can facilitate Thu 9am PT. happy to run pre-read.

priya_sre: I can backfill as co-host if lina can't. both slots ok for me. :thumbsup:

matt_product: Need product engineering rep — @emily-sre we need someone from Search team to present RCA for the schema migration path.

emily-sre: I can do Fri 16:00 PT only. Thu conflicts with customer sync.

devon_infra: Draft postmortem is at https://docs.redwood.internal/pir/inc-2026-042 — pinged owners. Quick excerpt: 
```
Impact: writer pool p99 latency 1.2s -> 7.8s; ~15% error spike; root cause: regression in cache eviction on new runtime; duration ~12m
Action items: rollback kernel opt + add e2e test,
```

samir_ops: Good — Lina facilitator, Priya co-host, Emily to present product impact (Fri slot), Devon to review infra changes. Which slot we pick? If we pick Fri 16 PT we have Emily. Thu gives Lina but product rep missing.

jordan_support: Support needs to be present for customer notes. I can do both slots. I'll prepare customer-impact notes (list of orgs and support contacts).

lina_prod: If we do Thu 9am we can run a dry-run with the doc at 8:30 to triage action owners. Otherwise Fri 16 feels safer since product can present.

priya_sre: Can we poll? quick vote: reaction counts. :one: Thu 9am, :two: Fri 4pm

matt_product: +1 for Fri (2).

samir_ops: Ok consensus for Fri 4pm PT. I'll create the calendar invite and add read-ahead. Action owners: devon_infra - infra remediation plan, emily-sre - product impact summary, lina_prod - facilitator notes, jordan_support - customer-impact slides, priya_sre - flakiness e2e test PR. Please add action items to the doc.

samir_ops: calendar invite: https://meet.redwood/meet/INC-2026-042-pir — invite sent to attendees. If anyone cannot attend, ping here and we'll record.

incident-bot: Reminder: PIR pre-read required 24h before meeting. Current doc last edited 2026-03-09T11:04Z by devon_infra.

lina_prod: I'll run the pre-read at 2026-03-11T08:30PT. tagging owners: @devon_infra @emily-sre @jordan_support @priya_sre
